reference.title: Mac utility promo (cobalt)
reference.notes: The most finished: a 3D laptop tells the story (open, lid closes, it sleeps), one idea per beat, a black to cobalt to white colour journey and a frosted ice-blue status-card system with live micro-UI; heavy italic grotesk with serif italic second lines. Studied from what the page shows publicly; rebuilt in Moovi's own code (packages/library/src/kits/launch) with our own fonts, sounds and assets.

parts.role: floating product with a live status card
parts.name: Floating product with a live status card
parts.about: a two-part line (heavy grotesk, serif italic second half) over a floating product slab that bobs on a soft contact shadow, a frosted ice-blue status card with a live value under it

parts.name: Wordmark, tagline, address pill
parts.about: the real app icon pops, the wordmark rises out of its mask beside it, the tagline in serif italic, the address in a black pill the cursor clicks

parts.name: Scale slam
parts.about: the line lands from 1.42x in log space with velocity ghosts and keeps drifting

parts.name: Zoom through
parts.about: the shot grows in log space past the camera and burns out in blur; the next settles in from 90% and sharpens

parts.name: Tilt dolly
parts.about: a slow dolly in with a slight tilt that levels out, for an object on a floor

parts.name: Pill button
parts.about: a black (or accent) pill with its label and an arrow, pressing on the cursor's click

parts.name: Frosted status card
parts.about: an ice-blue frosted card with a mono caps label, a big live value counting up and a gradient gauge with a needle

parts.name: One soft bloom
parts.about: one big soft bloom of the accent off-centre that breathes slowly (a dark shot's only glow)

parts.name: Saturated gradient
parts.about: the accent as a full-frame vertical gradient, deep at the top and light at the bottom (a cobalt world)

parts.role: the agent two hours into a job
parts.name: Agent at work, lid open
parts.about: an open laptop drawn in real 3D at three-quarter on a navy stage, its screen live with the brand's site or an agent terminal streaming steps, the two-voice headline above

parts.name: Lid falls shut
parts.about: the open laptop lifts a touch in anticipation, the lid falls shut under gravity with the screen glow dying, lands with a thud and a 2-frame nudge, then settles as a closed slab

parts.name: Asleep with Z's
parts.about: the closed laptop breathing on the dark stage while outlined Z's rise and grow from the lid's far corner every fifth of a second

parts.name: Glyph punch on the sky
parts.about: the brand's initial as a giant heavy glyph with a round dot slams onto a cobalt-to-ice sky with a white shockwave ring, then creeps 3% and recoils into the next beat

parts.name: Wordmark streams in
parts.about: the giant glyph shrinks into the first letter of the wordmark while the other letters stream in from the right with a horizontal smear, the dot springs in, the tagline focuses in, and the closed laptop starts rising at the bottom edge

parts.role: from the brand to the product world
parts.name: Rise into the stack
parts.about: the centred wordmark flies to a corner bug as the closed laptop rises from below turning to three-quarter, then the headline rises and a frosted live status card arrives under it

parts.name: Claim with live status
parts.about: headline, the floating closed laptop re-posed to a fresh angle over a light pool, and a frosted ice card with a breathing green dot, a cycling name and a counter ticking up

parts.name: Claim with heat gauge
parts.about: the floating laptop turns as a white sheen crosses its lid; the ice card shows a big reading counting up, a heat-gradient gauge with two threshold ticks and mode chips focusing in

parts.name: Claim with battery floor
parts.about: the laptop re-poses to a front view; the ice card holds a battery whose green fill sits above a red threshold line and a percentage that drains a step at a time

parts.name: Done, then sleeps
parts.about: the laptop turns the other way; a toast with a green check morphs its icon into a dark sleep badge and swaps its text, and two solid Z's rise from the lid

parts.name: Claim carousel on one object
parts.about: two to four claims from the brand's items on one beat grid: each swap changes the two-voice headline, re-poses the laptop and blurs the one card's content to the next live widget while the glass container stays

parts.name: Lid opens on the site
parts.about: on the sky the closed laptop's lid swings open with a slight overshoot and the brand's own site shot lights the screen in perspective (an agent terminal when there is no shot)

parts.name: White card, black address pill
parts.about: on white with a faint tint at the top: the big slanted wordmark with its dot, a two-line grotesk over serif italic lockup, a black address pill with an arrow that sharpens from grey, one line of grey fine print, a sheen later crossing the pill

parts.name: Grotesk over serif italic
parts.about: a two-line headline: the plain words in a heavy tight grotesk, the turn in a light serif italic on the line below; each line rises out of its mask with a short blur, 0.12 s apart, and leaves upward the same way

parts.name: Smear stream
parts.about: letters stream in from the left one after another, each dragging a horizontal smear of faint ghost copies and sharpening from blur

parts.name: Slant with a dot period
parts.about: words slide in from the right leaning hard, straighten to a heavy forward slant, and the final full stop becomes a round accent dot that springs in

parts.name: Name cycle with blur swaps
parts.about: the accent word's slot flicks through the brand's items every third of a second with two-frame blur swaps, greyed, then lands on the real word in full colour

parts.role: the pain world before the drop
parts.name: Navy spotlight stage
parts.about: a near-black navy ground, darkest in the corners, with a faint cool floor lift in an ellipse under the object (a soft light pool on light worlds)

parts.role: the product world after the drop
parts.name: Cobalt sky
parts.about: a vertical sky from deep indigo through the accent to pale ice at the bottom, built from the brand accent (a pale ice wash on light worlds)

parts.name: Corner wordmark bug
parts.about: the brand's slanted wordmark with its dot as a small bug in the top-left corner, sliding in and staying while claims run

parts.role: the device the agent works on
parts.name: Open laptop, live screen
parts.about: a silver laptop in real projected 3D at three-quarter with a hinged lid, slate keys, a trackpad, a soft contact shadow and the site shot (or a streaming agent terminal) mapped onto its screen in perspective

parts.role: the hero object of every claim
parts.name: Closed laptop floating
parts.about: a closed laptop as a two-layer rounded slab with a light rim, floating on a slow turntable with a contact shadow and a sheen crossing the lid, tinted by the world

parts.name: Agent step stream
parts.about: a dark terminal with traffic lights where an agent's steps append one by one as green-dotted lines with file paths, change counts in green and red, smooth scrolling and a shimmering working line at the bottom

parts.name: Shimmer status line
parts.about: a dark strip with a spinning star, a verb whose letters catch a light band running across them and a dim elapsed-time meta

parts.name: Live status ice card
parts.about: a frosted ice card: a green dot whose halo breathes, a caps state eyebrow, a bold name that cycles with blur swaps, a divider and a counter ticking up

parts.name: Heat gauge ice card
parts.about: a frosted ice card with a caps label over a big reading that counts up, a green-to-red heat gauge filling with it, two threshold ticks and pale mode chips focusing in one by one

parts.name: Battery threshold ice card
parts.about: a frosted ice card with a battery whose green fill sits above a red threshold line, a percentage that drains a step at a time with a blur flip, and a red caps note

parts.role: job done, then the machine sleeps
parts.name: Done-to-sleep toast
parts.about: a frosted toast with a round green check, a bold title and a grey meta line; the icon dips and morphs into a dark sleep badge and the text swaps to a calmer status

parts.name: Address pill with sheen
parts.about: a solid black rounded pill with the site address and an arrow that arrives grey and blurred, sharpens to black, and later a single slanted sheen crosses it

parts.role: sleep, idle, done for the day
parts.name: Sleep Z trail
parts.about: heavy slanted Z marks rising and growing from a point: outlined ones every fifth of a second while falling asleep, two solid ones holding once asleep

parts.name: Glyph flies at the lens
parts.about: the brand glyph, translucent, swells at the camera over the old shot in a few frames, one light frame on the cut, and keeps flying past over the new world

parts.role: the dark world flips to the sky on the drop
parts.name: Disc burst with shockwave
parts.about: the next world bursts open in a disc from the centre (or the next shot's entry point), a thin white ring overshooting outward and fading

parts.role: the sleep marks become the logo
parts.name: Z's converge into a mark
parts.about: three outlined Z's fly from the old shot's exit point to the centre, grow, fill in and burst past the camera onto the new shot

parts.role: from the product world to the CTA
parts.name: Scroll up into the next world
parts.about: the whole shot slides up while its bottom colour stretches below and fades into the next world's ground; the next shot rises through a blur

parts.name: Lid shuts over the frame
parts.about: a dark panel hinges down from the top edge like a laptop lid closing toward the lens (its free edge widening, a light rim on it) as the shot dims, then lifts off the next shot

parts.name: Anticipation lift
parts.about: before a mechanical action the shot eases up and toward the object, holds, then the action lands with a tiny two-frame nudge and it settles

parts.name: Steps on each claim
parts.about: the shot holds, then on each claim change takes a quick eased step in and sideways, with a slow drift between

parts.name: Creep, then recoil
parts.about: a slow 3.5% log-space creep in over the beat, then a quick 6% recoil in the last fifth of a second that hands the frame to the next beat

uses.role: sleep Z's rising from the lid
the sheen across the lid and the pill
headline exits upward through a blur
slow push on the stage beats
